Record Class TurStoreImportResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.viglet.turing.genai.provider.store.TurStoreImportResult
Record Components:
total - number of records read from the input file (lines that could be parsed as JSON)
imported - records successfully upserted into the collection — sum of preserved + reEmbedded, kept separately so the UI does not have to add up
preserved - records whose embedding was kept verbatim from the JSONL
reEmbedded - records whose embedding was missing/empty and was re-computed from content via the configured embedding model
failed - records the provider could not upsert (logged warnings, typically due to malformed embedding length, transport errors, or invalid metadata)
public record TurStoreImportResult(int total, int imported, int preserved, int reEmbedded, int failed) extends Record
Outcome summary of a JSONL import into a vector store collection. Used by the import endpoint to render a "what happened" panel similar to the SN exchange flow.
Since:
2026.2.4
